# Generated by ppc finalize (town_plans.py); do not edit by hand.

# ---- Plans whose producers need a higher location rank (town_plans.py) ----
# Location scope, in the plan's turn (pp_lplan_mark: forced, scope:pp_cplan_country set). Where none of the
# producers stands and the rank is below the lowest one they may stand on, the turn raises the rank (one step,
# pp_tplan_raise); else it runs the goods target. While the marks are measured the raise does nothing (it has no
# payback to offer). With the plan option "raise a settlement for its plan" off (pp_tplan_raise_off) the turn
# raises nothing and the plan waits for a higher rank (pp_lprof_fail 108, state 11). The trade plan's
# turn first asks its option "trade capacity in use" (pp_tplan_trade_use: below the line nothing happens here,
# 102.75, state 16) and, with a group of its buildings switched off, runs its groups one after the other
# (pp_tplan_trade_split).

pp_tplan_do_beer = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
			NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_level > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:brewery_mill building_type = building_type:brewery_manufactory building_type = building_type:beer_workshop building_type = building_type:brewery } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { pp_lplan_measuring = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_tplan_raise_off } }
				pp_lprof_fail = { r = 108 }
			}
			else = {
				pp_tplan_raise = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		pp_lprof_t_beer = yes
	}
}

pp_tplan_do_trade = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_hold value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_use } }
		scope:pp_cplan_country = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_lim value = pp_tplan_trade_use_pct } }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_tplan_trade_use_here < scope:pp_tplan_lim }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_hold value = 1 }
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 102.75 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_tplan_hold < 0.5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
				NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_level > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:commerce_center building_type = building_type:grand_marketplace building_type = building_type:merchants_quarters building_type = building_type:clearing_house building_type = building_type:customs_house building_type = building_type:entrepot building_type = building_type:market_warehouse building_type = building_type:marketplace building_type = building_type:port_authority building_type = building_type:stock_exchange building_type = building_type:trading_hub } } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { pp_lplan_measuring = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_tplan_raise_off } }
					pp_lprof_fail = { r = 108 }
				}
				else = {
					pp_tplan_raise = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:pp_cplan_country = {
						NOR = {
							has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_market_off
							has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_port_off
							has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_centre_off
						}
					}
				}
				pp_lprof_t_trade_category = yes
			}
			else = {
				pp_tplan_trade_split = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- The trade plan with a group of its buildings switched off (plan options, 2026-11-20) ----
# Location scope, in the trade plan's turn (pp_tplan_do_trade, where it does not raise the rank). Its groups in
# start order, each only while its switch is on: the Marketplace line, the Port Authority, the market centre's
# buildings (pp_lprof_t_trade_market / _port / _centre: the same lists and start order as pp_lprof_t_trade_category,
# which runs while every group is on). A group runs where the groups before it have nothing to do (every building
# at its highest level, or none can be built here; no construction) and, after the first group that ran, not while
# the plans are being measured. Nothing to do anywhere: "nothing to build" (101) where a group is at its highest
# level, else "cannot be built here" (102); every group switched off: state 16 (102.75).
pp_tplan_trade_split = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_ff value = 0 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_market_off } }
			NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_st }
			OR = {
				scope:pp_tplan_tried < 0.5
				NOT = { pp_lplan_measuring = yes }
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_fail }
				var:pp_lprof_fail < 102.25
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = pp_lprof_fail
				var:pp_lprof_fail < 101.25
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_ff value = 1 }
		}
		remove_variable = pp_lprof_fail
		remove_variable = pp_lprof_best
		pp_lprof_t_trade_market = yes
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_port_off } }
			NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_st }
			OR = {
				scope:pp_tplan_tried < 0.5
				NOT = { pp_lplan_measuring = yes }
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_fail }
				var:pp_lprof_fail < 102.25
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = pp_lprof_fail
				var:pp_lprof_fail < 101.25
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_ff value = 1 }
		}
		remove_variable = pp_lprof_fail
		remove_variable = pp_lprof_best
		pp_lprof_t_trade_port = yes
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_centre_off } }
			NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_st }
			OR = {
				scope:pp_tplan_tried < 0.5
				NOT = { pp_lplan_measuring = yes }
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_fail }
				var:pp_lprof_fail < 102.25
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = pp_lprof_fail
				var:pp_lprof_fail < 101.25
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_ff value = 1 }
		}
		remove_variable = pp_lprof_fail
		remove_variable = pp_lprof_best
		pp_lprof_t_trade_centre = yes
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_st }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_fail }
				var:pp_lprof_fail < 102.25
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:pp_tplan_ff > 0.5
					AND = {
						has_variable = pp_lprof_fail
						var:pp_lprof_fail < 101.25
					}
				}
			}
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_fail
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 101 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_tplan_tried > 0.5 }
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 102 }
		}
		else = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_fail
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 102.75 }
		}
	}
}

# ---- The food plan's turn (2026-11-20, Jan: farms first, kitchens second, a Tavern only when the store is short) ----
# Location scope, in the plan's turn (pp_lplan_mark). First the staple food producers (pp_lprof_t_food_farms; a new one
# starts where it pays best here, the food rule's return). Where they have nothing to do (every one at its highest
# level, or none can be built here; no construction) and the plans are not being measured: the kitchens (their cap
# follows the province's farms), with the taverns while the province's store is short by the food rule's own line
# (NOT pp_pclose_store_ok, province scope). Nothing to do there either: "nothing to build" (2) where the farms or
# the kitchens are at their highest level, else "cannot be built here" (6). The plan's buildings (the plan closer,
# the settings, the picker) stay its whole list (pp_lprof_t_food is not run).
# The plan's options (town_plans.py "Plan options", all unset = the above): the store limit (FOOD_STORE_VAR: nothing
# while the province's stored months, pp_location_stored_months, reach it: 102.75, state 16), the farms
# and the kitchens switched off, the Taverns never / while the store is short / always. Where every part is
# switched off, nothing is tried: state 16 (102.75).
pp_tplan_do_food = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_hold value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_store } }
		scope:pp_cplan_country = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_lim value = pp_tplan_food_store_months } }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_location_stored_months >= scope:pp_tplan_lim }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_hold value = 1 }
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 102.75 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_tplan_hold < 0.5 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_farms_off } } }
			pp_lprof_t_food_farms = yes
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_st }
				NOT = { pp_lplan_measuring = yes }
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_fail }
					var:pp_lprof_fail < 102.25
				}
			}
			# the farms' outcome: 101 = at their highest level, else 102
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_ff value = 102 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = pp_lprof_fail
					var:pp_lprof_fail < 101.25
				}
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_ff value = 101 }
			}
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_fail
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_best
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_kitchens_off } }
					OR = {
						AND = {
							scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_taverns } }
							province ?= { NOT = { pp_pclose_store_ok = yes } }
						}
						scope:pp_cplan_country = {
							has_variable = pp_tplan_food_taverns
							var:pp_tplan_food_taverns > 2.5
						}
					}
				}
				pp_lprof_t_food_kitchens_taverns = yes
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_kitchens_off } } }
				pp_lprof_t_food_kitchens = yes
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_taverns } }
							province ?= { NOT = { pp_pclose_store_ok = yes } }
						}
						scope:pp_cplan_country = {
							has_variable = pp_tplan_food_taverns
							var:pp_tplan_food_taverns > 2.5
						}
					}
				}
				pp_lprof_t_food_taverns = yes
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_tried value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_st }
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_fail }
						var:pp_lprof_fail < 102.25
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							scope:pp_tplan_ff < 101.5
							AND = {
								has_variable = pp_lprof_fail
								var:pp_lprof_fail < 101.25
							}
						}
					}
					remove_variable = pp_lprof_fail
					pp_lprof_fail = { r = 101 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_tplan_tried > 0.5 }
					pp_lprof_fail = { r = 102 }
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = pp_lprof_fail
					pp_lprof_fail = { r = 102.75 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: the next rank up, from the rank below it (Towns and Buildings' upgrade, paid from the
# Locations group's purse: pp_cplan_country_rank_up why = 105). Its state: 1 started, 7 gold (the purse saves
# for it), 8 the market lacks the upgrade's construction goods, 11 the rank cannot be raised here now (only
# conquered, a modifier forbids it, the population is below the rank's minimum, or the game refused it).
pp_tplan_raise = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement }
		pp_tplan_raise_town = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		pp_tplan_raise_city = yes
	}
	else = {
		pp_lprof_fail = { r = 108 }
	}
	# the ledger's step and value of the next construction in this turn
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_rs value = 0 }
}

pp_tplan_raise_town = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				integration_level = conquered
				modifier:cannot_upgrade_location = yes
				population < 5
			}
		}
		pp_lprof_fail = { r = 108 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { pp_cplan_country_goods_town = yes } }
		pp_lprof_fail = { r = 105 }
		pp_cplan_note_goods = { why = 105 }
	}
	else = {
		scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_wait }
		pp_cplan_country_rank_up = { rank = town n = 101 why = 105 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_st value = 101 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_wait } }
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 107 }
		}
		else = {
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 108 }
		}
		scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_wait }
	}
}

pp_tplan_raise_city = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				integration_level = conquered
				modifier:cannot_upgrade_location = yes
				population < 30
			}
		}
		pp_lprof_fail = { r = 108 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { pp_cplan_country_goods_city = yes } }
		pp_lprof_fail = { r = 105 }
		pp_cplan_note_goods = { why = 105 }
	}
	else = {
		scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_wait }
		pp_cplan_country_rank_up = { rank = city n = 102 why = 105 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_st value = 101 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_wait } }
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 107 }
		}
		else = {
			pp_lprof_fail = { r = 108 }
		}
		scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_wait }
	}
}

# ---- Plan settings (country scope; the settings tab's buttons, scripted_guis/pp_town_plan_settings.txt) ----
# scope:pp_key = flag:all or flag:<plan>: its payback limit one step $dir$ (up = longer, down = shorter).
pp_tplan_pb_key = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_key
		flag:all = { pp_tplan_pb_step = { var = pp_tplan_pb_all dir = $dir$ all = yes } }
		flag:camels = { pp_tplan_pb_step = { var = pp_tplan_pb_camels dir = $dir$ all = no } }

	}
	pp_tplan_pb_refresh = yes
}

# The payback limit $var$ one step $dir$. It starts from its own step, else (a plan, $all$ = no) from the
# all-plans step, else from any payback (13). The all-plans limit at any payback is unset; a plan keeps its
# own value, any payback too.
pp_tplan_pb_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = $var$ }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = var:$var$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { always = $all$ }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = 13 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_pb_all }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = var:pp_tplan_pb_all }
	}
	else = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = 13 }
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_new value = pp_tplan_pb_next_$dir$ }
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = $all$
			scope:pp_tplan_new > 12.5
		}
		remove_variable = $var$
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = $var$ value = scope:pp_tplan_new }
	}
}

# pp_tplan_pb_some while a payback limit is set anywhere (the pass then works out the estimates of first levels
# and tier upgrades, pp_lplan_location_turn).
pp_tplan_pb_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = pp_tplan_pb_all
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_pb_camels var:pp_tplan_pb_camels < 12.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_pb_elephants var:pp_tplan_pb_elephants < 12.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_pb_horses var:pp_tplan_pb_horses < 12.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_pb_livestock var:pp_tplan_pb_livestock < 12.5 }

# ---- Plan options (country scope; the Plans tab's buttons, scripted_guis/pp_town_plan_settings.txt) ----
# scope:pp_key = flag:all or flag:<goods plan>: its lowest production efficiency one step $dir$ (up = higher).
pp_tplan_eff_key = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_key
		flag:all = { pp_tplan_eff_step = { var = pp_tplan_effv_all dir = $dir$ all = yes } }
		flag:camels = { pp_tplan_eff_step = { var = pp_tplan_effv_camels dir = $dir$ all = no } }
		flag:elephants = { pp_tplan_eff_step = { var = pp_tplan_effv_elephants dir = $dir$ all = no } }
		flag:horses = { pp_tplan_eff_step = { var = pp_tplan_effv_horses dir = $dir$ all = no } }

# scope:pp_key = flag:<goods plan>: its line is the all-plans one again.
pp_tplan_eff_key_reset = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_key
		flag:camels = { remove_variable = pp_tplan_effv_camels }
		flag:elephants = { remove_variable = pp_tplan_effv_elephants }
		flag:horses = { remove_variable = pp_tplan_effv_horses }

# The line $var$ one step $dir$, from its own step, else (a plan, $all$ = no) the all-plans step, else none (0).
# Below the first step: none (the all-plans line unset; a plan's own none is 14).
pp_tplan_eff_step = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = $var$ }
		if = {
			limit = { var:$var$ < 13.5 }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = var:$var$ }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { always = $all$ }
			has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_all
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = var:pp_tplan_effv_all }
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_new value = pp_tplan_eff_next_$dir$ }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_tplan_new > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = $var$ value = scope:pp_tplan_new }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { always = $all$ }
		remove_variable = $var$
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 14 }
	}
}

# pp_tplan_effv_some while a line holds anywhere (the pass then works out the location's lasting production
# efficiency, pp_lplan_location_turn).
pp_tplan_eff_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_all
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_camels var:pp_tplan_effv_camels < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_elephants var:pp_tplan_effv_elephants < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_horses var:pp_tplan_effv_horses < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_livestock var:pp_tplan_effv_livestock < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_wool var:pp_tplan_effv_wool < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_beeswax var:pp_tplan_effv_beeswax < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_dyes var:pp_tplan_effv_dyes < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_incense var:pp_tplan_effv_incense < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_tobacco var:pp_tplan_effv_tobacco < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_cotton var:pp_tplan_effv_cotton < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_fiber_crops var:pp_tplan_effv_fiber_crops < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_silk var:pp_tplan_effv_silk < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_chili var:pp_tplan_effv_chili < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_cloves var:pp_tplan_effv_cloves < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_pepper var:pp_tplan_effv_pepper < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_saffron var:pp_tplan_effv_saffron < 13.5 }

				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_coal var:pp_tplan_effv_coal < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_alum var:pp_tplan_effv_alum < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_mercury var:pp_tplan_effv_mercury < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_saltpeter var:pp_tplan_effv_saltpeter < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_copper var:pp_tplan_effv_copper < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_iron var:pp_tplan_effv_iron < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_lead var:pp_tplan_effv_lead < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_tin var:pp_tplan_effv_tin < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_gems var:pp_tplan_effv_gems < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_goods_gold var:pp_tplan_effv_goods_gold < 13.5 }
				AND = { has_variable = pp_tplan_effv_silver var:pp_tplan_effv_silver < 13.5 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = pp_tplan_effv_some value = yes }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_tplan_effv_some
	}
}

# The Food plan's Taverns, the next state: while the store is short (unset) -> always -> never -> while short.
pp_tplan_food_taverns_next = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_taverns } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_tplan_food_taverns value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:pp_tplan_food_taverns > 2.5 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_tplan_food_taverns value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_tplan_food_taverns
	}
}

# The Food plan's store limit one step $dir$ (up = more months; past the last step: always, unset; from always
# down: the last step).
pp_tplan_food_store_step = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_food_store }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = var:pp_tplan_food_store }
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_new value = pp_tplan_food_store_next_$dir$ }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_tplan_new > 6.5 }
		remove_variable = pp_tplan_food_store
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = pp_tplan_food_store value = scope:pp_tplan_new }
	}
}

# The Trade plan's line of capacity in use one step $dir$ (up = a higher share; below the first step: always,
# unset; from always up: the first step).
pp_tplan_trade_use_step = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_trade_use }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_cur value = var:pp_tplan_trade_use }
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_tplan_new value = pp_tplan_trade_use_next_$dir$ }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_tplan_new < 0.5 }
		remove_variable = pp_tplan_trade_use
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = pp_tplan_trade_use value = scope:pp_tplan_new }
	}
}
